messages:
jia_metrics: FYI - overnight Prom spike from embed_vector_length labels ~02:14 UTC. Cardinality jumped huge, dashboards timed out. :grimacing:
sam_runtime: Was that the per-dim label change? Mixed-dim batches will create tons of (tenant,route,dim) series.
metrics-bot: ALERT: prometheus-cluster series_count > 120k at 02:14 UTC :rotating_light:
oscar_frontend: Graphs were unusable. We need a fast safety net and a reliable telemetry design.
maya_prod: Short term: ingest guardrails. Long term: preserve percentile fidelity without label explosion.
jia_metrics: Proposal: stop emitting freeform dim labels to Prom. Emit low-cardinality metrics + ship DDSketches to a metrics collector that materializes p50/p90/p99 numeric series.
sam_runtime: Short-term ship: ingress sampler that caps new (tenant,route,dim) label emission to 10/min and tags extras as dim=overflow. Runtime will also validate shape hints.
oscar_frontend: Console: default "Sketch percentiles" and opt-in "Sampled per-dim view". Show estimated error/confidence for percentiles.
infra_ops: Adding a collector is a ops tradeoff. Prefer materializing numeric aggregates back into Prom remote-write to avoid a new query path.
jia_metrics: Collector will own sketches, compute aggregates, and only write numeric series to Prom. Also keep top-K sampled dims in ClickHouse for the explorer.
maya_prod: Add a standardized optional header for client hints: `X-Embed-Shape: dims=1536;batch=3`. Runtime must validate and never blindly trust it for billing/routing.
sam_runtime: I'll PR sampler + header validation behind a flag today.
oscar_frontend: I'll mock the UI toggle + error visuals by EOW.
jia_metrics: I'll open the collector design doc in #eng-platform and ping infra for storage/runbook.
maya_prod: Owners set. Thanks team :thumbsup:
